scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && uv run python -m app.worker
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check app tests scripts
scripts.start: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.migration:import: cd backend && uv run python -m scripts.import_sqlite
scripts.migration:verify: cd backend && uv run python -m scripts.verify_migration
scripts.debate:e2e: cd backend && uv run python -m scripts.e2e_debate
scripts.source:feishu: cd backend && uv run python -m scripts.import_feishu_source
